notes.text: The organizer's own coverage (Bazaar of Moxen / Magic Bazar, bazaar-of-moxen.com) is gone, so mtgtop8 is the source. Placings are mtgtop8's: 1, 2, 3-4 and 5-8.
MTGGoldfish has the same Top 8 with an exact 1st-8th order and dates it 22 October, but two of its lists have impossible counts (a 59-card main deck and a 16-card sideboard), so it was not used.
